product.title: Cosrx Full Fit Propolis Synergy Toner
product.body_html:
An anhydrous toner that helps tone and soften the skin, containing 72.6% resin extract and 10% honey extract. It provides intense soothing effects while nourishing and strengthening the skin’s protective barrier. The toner has an essence-like texture that absorbs quickly, feels lightweight, and doesn’t leave any sticky residue. This "booster" toner activates skin regeneration processes, effectively soothes irritation, enhances skin resilience, restores damaged areas, balances pH levels, and nourishes the skin. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive and problem skin.

SIZE : 150ml / 5.07 fl. oz

 

BENEFITS

• Nourish for healthy skin
• Plump, glowing skin
• Reduce redness
• Improve skin texture


TARGETS

• Dull, dehydrated skin
• Red, irritated skin
• Great for all skin types and seasons

 

HOW TO USE

Apply the product as the first step in your skincare routine immediately after cleansing your face. Gently massage it onto your entire face for better absorption.
